name: Hanoi food guide
summary: Hanoi cooks a lighter, less sweet street food than the south. Eat bun cha at lunch, pho in the morning, and egg coffee when you want to sit down.
body: The Old Quarter will feed you, and it will also sell you a worse bowl at a higher price if you never leave the first corner. Walk until you see a single-dish shop.
Dishes to plan: pho, bun cha, bun dau with fried tofu and shrimp paste, cha ca if you want a sit-down grilled-fish meal, and ca phe trung.
seoDescription: What to eat in Hanoi, from pho and bun cha to egg coffee.
